name: Crimson
source:
"Because you're a girl, a person who is good to be beside and protect."

A doctor at the lower level hospital Firm.
He looks after the protagonist after Knives brings her in.
He has a kind and calming personality, but there is a part of him that can indifferently see through things and find the real truths.

Age: [spoiler]26[/spoiler]
Real Name: [spoiler]Michael[/spoiler]
